description:
Welcome to the Vier Beauty affiliate family — we are so glad you're here. 🎉

I'm Judine Jasmin, the founder of Vier Beauty. I'm a licensed Esthetician and Chemist with my own beauty spa in Margate, Florida — and every product in our line was created from that hands-on expertise. Clean, cruelty-free,  and made right here in North America. That's the story your audience is going to love.

Here's everything you need to get started today.

———

🔑 YOUR AFFILIATE CODE

Your unique discount code 

This gives your audience 10% off their first order — and every sale made with your code earns you 15% commission, tracked automatically.


📱 YOUR SECRET WEAPON — THE FREE SKIN ADVISOR APP

This is what makes promoting Vier Beauty different from any other brand.

Instead of asking your audience to buy something, you're sharing a FREE AI Skin Advisor built by a real Esthetician — it analyzes their skin type and recommends the exact Vier Beauty products their skin needs.


👉 Share this link: https://skin-style-advisor.lovable.app

The best content shows you (or someone) taking the skin analysis and reacting to the results. Your audience clicks, takes the quiz, gets their personalized routine, and buys using your code. Simple, authentic, no hard sell.

———

🎬 WHAT TO POST — 4 CONTENT IDEAS THAT WORK

1. The Quiz Video

"I tried this free AI skin advisor and here's what it said about my skin..."

Film yourself taking the quiz in real time. Show your results. React. Done.

2. The Recommendation Video

Show the products the quiz recommended for your skin type. Link them with your code. Works great as a flat-lay or a quick talking-head video.

3. The Story Share

Post the app link to your Instagram or TikTok story with the text: "Free skin analysis — you actually need this 👇" One tap. Massive reach.

4. The Caption Post

Use this caption (or make it your own):

"Free AI skin quiz that actually works 🧬 Built by an Esthetician & Chemist — tells you exactly what your skin needs. Clean, vegan, cruelty-free products made in North America. Take the quiz → link in bio. Use [YOUR CODE] for 10% off 🌿 #skincare #cleanskincare #skintok #vierbeauty"

———

🗣️ WHAT TO SAY — YOUR TALKING POINTS

✅ DO say:

• "Built by a licensed Esthetician and Chemist"

• "Clean, cruelty-free, some vegan products, made in North America"

• "Free skin quiz — personalized to YOUR skin"

• "No parabens, no sulfates, no compromise"

🚫 PLEASE DON'T say:

• Any medical or dermatological claims (e.g. "cures acne", "treats eczema")

• Competitor brand comparisons

• Anything not listed in your affiliate portal

———

📁 YOUR BRAND ASSETS

All product photos, lifestyle images, the Vier Beauty logo, and a short video clip from me are available in your affiliate portal. Everything is ready to use — just download and post.

One last thing — I genuinely believe in the people I bring onto this team. You don't need to have the products in hand to share something real. You just need to believe in clean beauty — and share the tool that does the rest.

Any questions at all, just reply to this email. I'm always here.


Let's build something great together. 🌿


With love,

Judine Jasmin

Founder, Vier Beauty
